title: XDRIP on Samsung Smartwatch
symptom: The user asks if it is possible to scan a Freestyle Libre sensor with a Samsung smartwatch as a standalone solution, without any Bluetooth collector, just by holding the watch to the sensor.
cause: Samsung watches run Tizen OS and there are only Android applications available. Additionally, there are no applications for Wear OS (Android watches) that can NFC-scan the Libre sensor.
fix: No fix is provided; the answer is that it is not possible. xDrip runs on Wear OS but relies on a bridge device like BluKon or MiaoMiao which read the sensor via NFC and send data via Bluetooth to the watch or phone.
evidence_quote: No, not possible. Samsung watches run tizen os and there are only android applications available.
